text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: It's the new year, Trainer! Now that I'm in my senior year, I'll finally be able to fly to Europe!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: But first, let's head over to the shrine for some godly guidance!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Godly guidance… I guess that's what Pearl calls New Year's shrine visits.
choice_data_list: Is there any other special New Year's vocabulary I should know about?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Yeah, there's a bunch. There's the first sun supplication and chaos bag buying…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: And you can't forget the purse money you get during New Year's! I'm not picky either. I accept US dollars as well as Japanese yen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm sure she means "pocket money," but I still understood her. I take this moment to hand her the modest gift I'd prepared for her.
choice_data_list: Here, Pearl, this is for you.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Oh my, really? Aww, you really didn't have to, since I'm not a kid or anything.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She takes the New Year gift envelope and peeks inside.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: A piece of paper? I thought it was a bill, but it really is just a sheet of paper… Hm, looks like there's something written on it…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A single line is carefully written on the page. It reads…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: "Prix Jacques Le Marois."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: This is a summer G1 mile race that's held in France! Trainer, can this be?
choice_data_list: Yup, it's my New Year's gift for you.
Yup, it's my New Year's gift for you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: What I gave her is the name of a European G1 race that I selected as her main goal for this year.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I can't believe it! This is the best gift ever! I'm so excited, I can't even contain myself!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: OHOHOHO! KYAAAHOHOHO!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her intense excitement warps her signature laugh. She appears to be absolutely elated.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Wow, the Prix Jacques Le Marois, eh? This is quite the tall order…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: It's considered one of the two biggest events among French G1 miles.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: If I were to win there, I'd be recognized as a world-class Umamusume without question.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Running 1,600 meters on a track with deep turf will be a high hurdle to overcome, though…
choice_data_list: Would you prefer a safer option?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Non! I just need to make up for what I lack.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: And then, I'll make my dreams come true and give hope to people all around the world!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Now that I have a goal, it's time to go get some godly guidance!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Together, Seeking the Pearl and I go to a shrine and make our prayers.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: It'll take more than godly guidance to bring me success while in unfamiliar French territory. I'll need to run some simulations too.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: For figuring out the best ways to take on and beat my fellow racers in France!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Trainer, what should I do during the New Year's holiday?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's tons we could consider to prepare for her trip to France. For example…
choice_data_list: Have a Japan vs. France video game showdown.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: French cuisine! Of course, what's more important than getting accustomed to the food of your target country?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I'll need to eat a variety of foods to train my palate. Time to sample different cuisines to our hearts' content!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Let's see… So this is galette, this is confit, and this is poêlée…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I see. I think I've grasped the basics of French food.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: That there's no need to worry about how food is prepared! Because in the end, food is food!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: If it tastes good, that's all that matters. Now let's clear our heads and dig in!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl empties her mind and fills her stomach. Although she doesn't gain any culinary expertise, she does gain some energy back.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Practice French, huh? Wonderful idea! Assimilating with the locals is definitely important, and what better way to do that than with language!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Let's spend New Year's speaking French, then!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Bonjour, chocolatier! Could I get some of that très bien chocolate, s'il vous plaît?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Oui, oui! Okay, I'll have the Mont Blanc too! Haha! With a bit of practice, I'll be able to go from being bilingual to trilingual!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite Seeking the Pearl's confidence in her language skills, it's not so much her broken French that helps people understand her but her body language.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: A Japan versus France showdown! Well, I don't know anything about how French fighters engage in battle…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: But that matters not! I'll beat them down in a battle royale! Trainer, let's hit up an Internet cafe!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Gah, they really know how to take cover! I wonder if this strategy is popular in France.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Trainer, now's your chance! Use a grenade! As if they'll beat us! I learned beaucoup de tricks for outsmarting people from my grandmother!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl picks up a variety of game strategies, some of which should prove useful in her future races.
